definitions.explanation: The eighth month of the year. The hottest month, featuring Obon (mid-August), a time to honor ancestors.

examples.japanese: {八月|はちがつ}は{暑|あつ}いです。
{八月|はちがつ}に{海|うみ}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I go to the sea in August.

examples.japanese: {八月|はちがつ}は{夏休|なつやす}みなので、{旅行|りょこう}する{人|ひと}が{多|おお}いです。
examples.english: August is summer vacation, so many people travel.

examples.japanese: {八月|はちがつ}のお{盆|ぼん}には{実家|じっか}に{帰|かえ}る{人|ひと}がたくさんいます。
examples.english: Many people go back to their parents' home during Obon in August.

examples.japanese: {八月|はちがつ}は{毎日|まいにち}{暑|あつ}くて、エアコンがないと{生活|せいかつ}できません。
examples.english: August is hot every day, and you can't live without air conditioning.

notes:
{八月|はちがつ} is August - literally "month eight."

MONTH PATTERN:
Number + {月|がつ} = month name
- {八|はち} (8) + {月|がつ} = August

CULTURAL NOTES:
- お{盆|ぼん} (mid-August): Major holiday when people return to hometowns to honor ancestors
- {夏休|なつやす}み: Summer vacation period for schools
- {花火|はなび}{大会|たいかい}: Fireworks festivals are common
- Hottest month in Japan

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {八月|はちがつ}{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}: mid-August
- {八月|はちがつ}{末|まつ}: end of August
